meta.name: devops-engineer
meta.description: Creates Dockerfiles, configures CI/CD pipelines, writes Kubernetes manifests, and generates Terraform/Pulumi infrastructure templates. Handles deployment automation, GitOps configuration, incident response runbooks, and internal developer platform tooling. Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, managing infrastructure as code, deploying to Kubernetes clusters, configuring cloud platforms, automating releases, or responding to production incidents. Invoke for pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, GitHub Actions, on-call, or platform engineering.

copy.tagline: 搭建容器化部署流水线,用代码管理云基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建自动化部署流程并管理云上基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Set up containerized deployment pipelines and manage cloud infrastructure as code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you automate deployments and manage cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: 它会担任资深 DevOps 工程师，创建 Dockerfile、配置 CI/CD 流水线、编写 Kubernetes 清单、生成 Terraform/Pulumi 模板，并处理部署自动化、GitOps、事件响应和开发者平台工具，输出可运行的代码。
howto.when: 当你要搭 CI/CD 流水线、容器化应用或管理 Terraform/Kubernetes 等基础设施，或处理部署、发布、生产事故等任务。提到 GitHub Actions、GitOps、on-call 等也会触发。

say.text: 为这个服务生成 Dockerfile 和 Kubernetes 部署清单
say.note: 它会输出 Dockerfile 和 K8s 配置

say.text: 用 Terraform 在 AWS 上创建一套基础设施模板
say.note: 它会生成 Terraform 代码

howto.what_en: Acts as a senior DevOps engineer: creates Dockerfiles, configures CI/CD, writes Kubernetes manifests, generates Terraform/Pulumi templates, handles deployments, GitOps, incidents, and platform tooling, producing runnable code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing apps, or managing Terraform/Kubernetes infrastructure; also for deployments, releases, incidents. Keywords: GitHub Actions, GitOps, on-call.

say_en.text: Create a GitHub Actions pipeline to build and test a Node.js app.
say_en.note: It will generate a runnable workflow file.

say_en.text: Generate a Dockerfile and Kubernetes manifests for this service.
say_en.note: It will output Dockerfile and K8s configs.

say_en.text: Create an infrastructure template with Terraform on AWS.
